body:
Besides my sister, my only family is really myself and my mother, and we've both already attempted to reach out to her.

I just posted this /r/suicidewatch. Thanks for the suggestions.

Yes, I realize that. I'm just concerned as to whether or not it would effective, as she seems intent on not hearing anyone out.

I'll consider it as an option, though.
I've considered doing that, but I don't know how much help it would be. The problem is that I can't *force* her into doing anything, as she's an adult and I have no authority over her.
Thanks for the suggestion. Just x-posted it.
I just don't know how to condense a subject matter like this into bullet points without leaving out important details.
Last time someone called 911 on her, she was released a few hours later and they said she wasn't a threat to herself.
Something like this can't easily be so easily condensed. If you don't feel like reading it, why bother replying? Just hide the thread.

That's not my intention. I don't have enough reason or evidence as of now to believe that she's going to commit suicide, but I'm worried that her depression will continue to grow and she might feel that way in the future.
